record_title: A curvature obstruction and implication gap in the Rubel(1)=Rubel(2) proof
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: This record identifies proof gaps in arXiv:2609.20607v1; it does not disprove Rubel(1)=Rubel(2) or the stated simply connected corollary, and it supplies no counterexample to either statement. The finite-inner-diameter implication to Rubel(1) is elementary and is not claimed as new. Older full-text sources by Gordon and Hinchliffe were not fully inspected, and the principal preprint is very recent, so a later revision or contemporaneous correction remains possible. No independent validation is asserted.
